notes: Variant WLC.EZK.14.4.v001 selected r01, covering s046–s047; the retained reading is what the ASV's *therein* renders, so no rule 53 case arises.
אִישׁ אִישׁ is split *Every* / *man* rather than fused, since the ASV spends a word on each (rule 2).
The object marker אוֹתָם takes the *unto* through which *speak* reaches its object (rule 16, first family), while the אֵת of s022 is unrepresented before a bare English object.
